The issuer exhibits very strong operational profitability with an 85% gross margin and 32% operating margin, backed by substantial quarterly revenue of $20.88 billion and net income of $2.971 billion. However, its balance sheet shows significant liquidity risk and leverage, characterized by a very low current ratio of 0.35 ($56.5 billion in current assets versus $159.6 billion in current liabilities) and a highly leveraged capital structure with equity of only $34 billion against $274.9 billion in total liabilities. This combination of highly profitable operations but a highly leveraged, liquidity-constrained balance sheet aligns with a low investment-grade or high speculative-grade rating.

DECISION: BB+
